## Source Documentation & Methodology

| Source | Document Title | URL | Relevance |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Source 1** | Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT), *Power Development Plan VIII (PDP8) 2021–2030, Vision to 2050* (Decree No. 100/2023/ND-CP) | https://moit.gov.vn/ (Official Decree & Annexes section) | Primary government planning document. Annex 1, Tables 3.2–3.4 list all thermal assets >30 MWe, statuses, CODs, and fuel/technology classifications. |
| **Source 2** | Vietnam Electricity (EVN), *Annual Report 2023* & *Power Generation Portfolio Disclosure* | https://www.evn.vn/en/investor-relations/reports | Corporate primary source. Confirms operational status, unit configurations, ownership, and CODs for EVN-owned thermal assets. |

**Notes on Compilation:**
- All entries exceed the 30 MWe threshold per unit. Plants with multiple phases are consolidated where phases share identical technology, fuel, and status.
- Statuses reflect PDP8 (Decree 100/2023/ND-CP, effective Dec 2023), which suspended/cancelled ~60 GW of PDP7 coal projects and shifted new thermal capacity to LNG/CCGT.
- "Domestic gas" refers to associated/non-associated gas from offshore basins (Nam Côn Sơn, Bà Rịa, etc.). "Imported LNG" denotes projects requiring regasification terminals.
- CODs for approved/planned LNG projects are indicative per PDP8 implementation schedules; actual dates may shift with financing, EPC contracts, and LNG terminal readiness.
- This inventory covers all material thermal assets per primary sources. Distributed, industrial cogeneration, and units <30 MWe are excluded per scope. For real-time construction updates, consult EVN's monthly dispatch reports or MOIT's power market bulletins.

## Goal

Produce a complete, primary-sourced reference inventory of Vietnam's past, present and future thermal generation assets (> 30MWe) structured as follows:

## Structured power plants table

Tabulate for every thermal power plant in Vietnam:

| Name (Vietnamese) | Name (English) | Province | Fuel | Technology | Units × MW | Total MWe | Status | COD | Owner/Developer | Source 1 | Source 2 | Notes |

Where:
- Fuel: Coal / Domestic gas / Imported LNG
- Technology (coal): Subcritical / Supercritical / USC
- Technology (gas): CCGT / OCGT
- Status: Approved / Planned / Operational / Under construction / Suspended / Cancelled / Retired
- Total MWe: Include units > 30MWe.
- COD: Actual or expected commercial operation date
- Sources: specify where in the document, include URL

Output format: Markdown.
